anna_sec: noticed a SAST critical blocked a main deploy earlier but Cloud Audit Logs show no KMS Decrypt event for the deploy service account in that window. can someone sanity-check? :mag:
raj_eng: i looked at the CI run: first decrypt failed, retried and succeeded ~18s later. GH Actions logs: 
  2026-03-21T09:11:05Z ERROR decrypt permission denied
  2026-03-21T09:11:23Z INFO retrying decrypt
  2026-03-21T09:11:25Z INFO decrypt ok
sophie_sre: sounds like ephemeral grant propagation. what's the TTL currently for keystore grants?
raj_eng: it's 40s for deploy grants to minimize blast radius.
anna_sec: that's probably too short for audit propagation. proposal: (1) bump TTL to 5m for deploy grants, (2) add a post-deploy GH Action that queries Cloud Logging for protoPayload.methodName="google.crypto.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" for the deploy-sa and marks the PR as "needs-security-approval" if missing, (3) record structured trace just before decrypt to correlate.
sophie_sre: agree. i'll add a tiny trace shim to echo JSON with trace_id to stdout before decrypt. also suggest the log-check action wait 30s after job end before querying to reduce false-positives.
raj_eng: for UX, the action should set a check status instead of hard-failing the PR, and attach the gcloud logging output if it fails. reduces noisy rollbacks.
ops-bot: [auto] opened SEC-688: "deploy KMS audit check + TTL bump" assigned to @anna_sec. link: https://github.internal/redwood/security/SEC-688
anna_sec: i'll file infra request for role/grant change (grant cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to ci-audit-reader) and increase logging retention to 90d. i'll also draft the GH Action and runbook steps for sec oncall. thanks all. :v:
